div.p: Comprehensive manual for direct hardware background printing, multi-branch routing, and developer integration.
To establish communication between Odoo and your enterprise Print Hub server:

ol.li: Navigate to Print Hub ➔ Configuration ➔ Settings.
Enter the API Key (X-API-Key) generated from your Print Hub Admin Panel.
Click the "🔗 Test Connection" button to confirm live connectivity and inspect the count of online hardware agents.
Click "🔄 Sync Printers Now" to import all discovered local printers, profiles, and printer pools.

div.p:
When a document is printed, Print Hub determines the destination hardware in this order:
1. Manual Wizard Selection ➔ 2. Matched Routing Rule ➔ 3. Active Branch Default ➔ 4. User Profile Preference ➔ 5. Global Default.
You can trigger direct physical printing from any supported document form or list view via the Action (⚙️) menu:

ul.li: Supported Core Models: Job Cards (job.card), Invoices (account.move), Delivery Orders (stock.picking), and Sales Orders (sale.order).
Action Menu: Select Action ➔ 🖨️ Cetak ke Print Hub.
Branch Printer Status: The wizard displays live availability badges (🟢 Online or 🔴 Offline).
Single & Batch Printing: Select multiple records in a list view and launch the wizard to spool all documents simultaneously.

div.p: Before committing to paper, click the "👁️ Pratinjau (Preview)" button inside the wizard. The document will be rendered and previewed inside the window, preventing paper wastage and formatting errors.
The approval workflow is a toggleable feature designed for sensitive documents (e.g. Invoices, Official Delivery Slips, High-Value Job Cards):

ul.li: Global Switch: In Settings, check "Enable Print Approval Workflow". If disabled, all documents print immediately without approval delays.
Rule Level: In Document Routing Rules, check "Require Manager Approval" on specific report templates.
Pending State: When a print job is generated under an approval rule, its status is set to ⏳ Pending Approval and physical spooling is paused.
Manager Action: Users with the Print Hub: Manager role can navigate to Print Jobs, inspect the request, and click "✅ Approve Print" or "❌ Reject".

div.p: Any custom Odoo model can enable enterprise background printing by inheriting print.hub.mixin:
Because your model inherits print.hub.mixin, you have automatic access to the print_hub_job_count field and action_view_print_jobs() method for adding a print history smart button to your form view:

tr.td: Print documents via wizard or direct actions; view own print history.
View all branch jobs; manage routing rules & schedules; approve/reject jobs.
Configure server endpoint, API keys, webhook HMAC secret, hardware sync.

div.b: Q: Why is my target printer showing "Offline"?
div.p: A: Physical printers appear offline if the branch workstation running the Print Hub Agent client is turned off or disconnected from the local network. Make sure the agent tray app is running.

div.b: Q: What happens if a physical printer runs out of paper?
div.p: A: Print Hub records the hardware alert in real time. The Odoo job status switches to Failed, an error message is recorded in the job's Chatter, and a To-Do Activity is automatically created for the user.

div.b: Q: How does Webhook HMAC verification protect my system?
div.p: A: By setting a Webhook HMAC Secret in Settings, every callback from Print Hub is signed using SHA-256. Unauthorized external calls to /print-hub/webhook are rejected with HTTP 403.
